headline: Altius Minerals Corporation Closes Transaction Increasing Ownership Interest in Great Bay Renewables and Announces Increased Credit Facility
summary: ST. JOHN’S, Newfoundland and Labrador, July 30, 2026--Altius Minerals Corporation (TSX: ALS) (OTCQX: ATUSF) ("Altius") is pleased to announce the successful closing of the transaction, originally announced on July 10, 2026, to increase its effective ownership interest in Great Bay Renewable Holdings, LLC and Great Bay Renewable Holdings II, LLC ("collectively, "GBR") to 50%.
